Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning reserve account and study requirements for condominium associations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reserve account and study requirements forcondominium associations; and adding a new section to chapter 64.34RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 64.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A condominium association is not required to follow therequirements under RCW 64.34.380 through 64.34.390 if: (1) The association has ten or fewer condominium owners; and (2) Twothirds of the owners agree to exempt the association fromRCW 64.34.380 through 64.34.390.
